children: Viking Holdings' board approved a $1 billion share-repurchase plan.

Chief Executive Leah Talactac said Thursday that the authorization reflects confidence in the cruise company's long-term prospects, financial positioning and ability to continue generating substantial cash flow.
"This authorization provides flexibility to return capital to shareholders while continuing to invest in our fleet, guest experience and future growth opportunities," she said.

The buybacks will be executed through means including open-market purchases and privately negotiated deals, Viking said. It noted that it has no obligation to repurchase shares and can suspend or discontinue the program at any time.
